column2: Welcome to STEP Library. Here's a one-minute tour.
First, sign in with your Google account.
Your email needs to be registered with the library.
To find a book, search by title or author.
Available shows how many copies are on the shelf.
None left means every copy is out.
Then point your camera at the QR code on the book.
That's it. The book is yours.
The Reading tab lists every book you have out,
and how long you've had it.
To return, tap Scan QR on Reading.
You can rate it if you like. It's optional.
Past reads keeps every book you've returned.
You can change a rating any time.
